title: svalbard_phippsoya_20060829
author: jeo
changes: Atlantic walrus (Odobenus rosmarus rosmarus) bellowing in a group resting on the beach of Phippsøya, Svalbard. Trimmed to 604.70–606.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass so the low bellow (about 150–300 Hz) keeps its depth.
